title: Cache and keep-alive
description: Does the cache pay, and do pings pay?

panels.title: Cache read ratio
panels.description: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_write + input). Output tokens are not part of the prompt.

panels.title: Misses by cause
panels.description: Cache misses, by why. Each bar is the count in that bar's time span. The span grows with the dashboard range and is at least 5 minutes.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cause)((increase(llm_cache_misses_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_cache_misses_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_cache_misses_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_cache_misses_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_cache_misses_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])), "cause", "unattributed", "cause", "")

panels.title: Miss cost by cause (USD, selected range)
panels.description: The extra amount paid because the prefix was written again instead of read: cache-write tokens priced at the write rate minus the read rate (docs/metrics/spec.md 5.4). Output and fresh input are not in it. A model with no rate counts the miss and books no money.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cause)((increase(llm_cache_miss_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_cache_miss_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_cache_miss_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_cache_miss_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_cache_miss_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])), "cause", "unattributed", "cause", "")

panels.title: Ping outcomes
panels.description: Pings, by outcome. A timeout is a ping that ran to its 60 s limit; it is booked at its projected cost (#754). A skipped ping leaves no row, so it does not show. unattributed is an older cortex build, which did not label the outcome. Each bar is the count in that bar's time span. The span grows with the dashboard range and is at least 5 minutes.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (outcome)((increase(llm_keepalive_pings_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_pings_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_pings_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_pings_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_pings_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])), "outcome", "unattributed", "outcome", "")

panels.title: Pings that paid
panels.description: Rescue value divided by ping cost over the selected range. Above 1, the pings paid. No data means the ping cost did not increase in the range.

targets.expr: (sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__range])) - sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__range]))) / ((sum((increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Estimated ping cost
panels.description: Share of the ping cost that is not a measured figure. Each proxy books a different part here. context-guru: pings that timed out with no answer, booked at their projected cost (#754). cortex: pings priced from a fallback rate, because the model has no rate of its own, and pings that timed out, booked at the keeper's projected cost. No data means the ping cost did not increase in the range.

targets.expr: sum((increase(llm_keepalive_estimated_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_estimated_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_estimated_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_estimated_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_estimated_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) / ((sum((increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__range)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Keep-alive: cost, rescue and net (USD)
panels.description: Do the pings pay? The rescue is a write that became a read, so its value is the write saved minus the read paid. Ping cost is below zero, rescue above, and the line is the net. Each bar is the dollars in that bar's time span. The span grows with the dashboard range and is at least 5 minutes.

targets.expr: -sum((increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval]))

((sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)) - (sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)))

(((sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="saved"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)) - (sum((increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_savings_cache_effect_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine",effect="rescue",direction="added"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))) - sum((increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) and last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[30d] offset $__interval)) or (increase(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval] anchored) >= last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])) or last_over_time(llm_keepalive_cost_usd_total{proxy=~"$proxy", machine=~"$machine"}[$__interval])))
